description: Agents menu item appears in sidebar navigation between Intel and Reports
steps: Step 1: Load application and authenticate
Step 2: Check sidebar navigation items
Step 3: Verify 'Agents' menu item exists with robot/AI icon
Step 4: Confirm position is between Intel and Reports
Step 5: Click on Agents and verify navigation to /agents route

description: Agents hub page displays grid of available agent cards
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents
Step 2: Verify page title shows 'Agents Hub' or similar
Step 3: Check agent cards are displayed in grid layout
Step 4: Verify each card shows: icon, name, description, 'Generate' button
Step 5: Confirm at least 6 agent types are visible: Email, Landing Page, Social Media, Ad Copy, Video Script, Content Strategy

description: Agents hub requires client selection before generation
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents
Step 2: Click on any agent card
Step 3: Verify client selector is prominently displayed
Step 4: Attempt to generate without selecting client
Step 5: Confirm error message or disabled state prevents generation
Step 6: Select a client and verify generate button becomes enabled

description: Context Engine assembles full client context when client is selected
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents and select Email agent
Step 2: Select a client with brand voice defined
Step 3: Open browser dev tools Network tab
Step 4: Verify API call to /api/agents/context/:clientId is made
Step 5: Check response includes: brand_voice, icp_data, constitution_rules
Step 6: Verify response includes: top_performers, active_campaigns
Step 7: Confirm context is displayed or indicated in UI

description: Prompt Studio displays preset dropdown with multiple options
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents and select any copy agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Locate 'Prompt Preset' or 'Tone' dropdown
Step 4: Click dropdown and verify options include: Conversion-focused, Consultative, Institutional, Friendly, Urgent
Step 5: Select different presets and verify selection is saved
Step 6: Confirm preset affects the system prompt used for generation

description: Prompt Studio allows custom prompt editing with variable interpolation
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents and select any agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Find 'Custom Prompt' or 'Advanced' toggle/button
Step 4: Expand custom prompt editor
Step 5: Verify textarea shows current system prompt template
Step 6: Edit prompt to include {{client_name}} and {{brand_voice}}
Step 7: Generate content and verify variables were interpolated correctly

description: Email Sequence Agent generates welcome email with all required elements
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents and select Email Sequence Agent
Step 2: Select a client with brand voice
Step 3: Choose 'Welcome Email' type
Step 4: Enter brief: 'Welcome new subscribers to our newsletter'
Step 5: Click Generate
Step 6: Wait for streaming response to complete
Step 7: Verify output includes: Subject line, Preview text, Email body
Step 8: Check email body contains: Greeting, Introduction, Key Benefits, First Steps, CTA
Step 9: Confirm tone matches brand voice of selected client

description: Email Sequence Agent generates abandoned cart email with urgency element
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents and select Email Sequence Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'Abandoned Cart' type
Step 4: Enter product name and brief
Step 5: Click Generate
Step 6: Verify output includes urgency/scarcity messaging
Step 7: Check product reminder is present
Step 8: Verify discount offer placeholder or actual offer is included
Step 9: Confirm strong CTA button copy is generated

description: Email Sequence Agent generates multi-email nurture sequence
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents and select Email Sequence Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'Nurture Sequence' type
Step 4: Set sequence length to 5 emails
Step 5: Enter sequence objective and brief
Step 6: Click Generate
Step 7: Verify 5 distinct emails are generated
Step 8: Check emails have logical progression
Step 9: Confirm each email has unique subject line
Step 10: Verify consistent brand voice across all emails

description: Email Agent generates subject line A/B variants
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Email Sequence Agent
Step 2: Select client and email type
Step 3: Enable 'Generate A/B Variants' option
Step 4: Click Generate
Step 5: Verify at least 3 subject line variants are generated
Step 6: Check variants have different approaches (curiosity, benefit, urgency)
Step 7: Confirm variants are clearly labeled A, B, C

description: Landing Page Agent generates complete landing page copy with all sections
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents and select Landing Page Agent
Step 2: Select a client with ICP data defined
Step 3: Enter landing page brief with product/service description
Step 4: Click Generate
Step 5: Wait for streaming response
Step 6: Verify output includes Hero section with headline and subheadline
Step 7: Check Problem section identifies pain points
Step 8: Verify Solution section presents the offer
Step 9: Confirm Features section with at least 3 features
Step 10: Check Social Proof section with testimonial framework
Step 11: Verify FAQ section with at least 3 Q&As
Step 12: Confirm CTA section with primary and secondary CTAs

description: Landing Page Agent generates SEO meta description
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Landing Page Agent
Step 2: Select client and enter brief
Step 3: Click Generate
Step 4: Verify output includes 'Meta Description' field
Step 5: Check meta description is under 160 characters
Step 6: Confirm it includes primary keyword and CTA

description: Social Media Agent generates Instagram single post caption
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents and select Social Media Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'Instagram Post' type
Step 4: Enter post topic and objective
Step 5: Click Generate
Step 6: Verify caption is generated with hook opening
Step 7: Check body provides value or story
Step 8: Confirm CTA is included
Step 9: Verify hashtag suggestions are provided
Step 10: Check character count is appropriate for Instagram

description: Social Media Agent generates Instagram carousel copy with slide-by-slide content
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Social Media Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'Instagram Carousel' type
Step 4: Set number of slides (e.g., 7)
Step 5: Enter carousel topic
Step 6: Click Generate
Step 7: Verify output includes copy for each slide numbered 1-7
Step 8: Check slide 1 has strong hook
Step 9: Verify middle slides provide value progression
Step 10: Confirm final slide has clear CTA
Step 11: Check caption copy is also generated separately

description: Social Media Agent generates Reels/TikTok script with timestamps
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Social Media Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'Reels/TikTok Script' type
Step 4: Enter video topic and target duration (30s)
Step 5: Click Generate
Step 6: Verify script includes Hook (0-3s) section
Step 7: Check Body section with problem/solution
Step 8: Verify CTA (final seconds) is included
Step 9: Confirm caption with hashtags is generated
Step 10: Check script includes visual/b-roll suggestions

description: Social Media Agent generates LinkedIn post with professional tone
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Social Media Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'LinkedIn Post' type
Step 4: Enter topic and key message
Step 5: Click Generate
Step 6: Verify tone is professional/business-appropriate
Step 7: Check post has strong opening line
Step 8: Verify body provides insights or value
Step 9: Confirm CTA or engagement question at end
Step 10: Check no excessive hashtags (max 3-5)

description: Social Media Agent generates Twitter/X thread
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Social Media Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'Twitter/X Thread' type
Step 4: Enter thread topic
Step 5: Click Generate
Step 6: Verify multiple tweets are generated (5-10)
Step 7: Check each tweet is under 280 characters
Step 8: Verify first tweet has strong hook
Step 9: Confirm tweets are numbered or have flow indicators
Step 10: Check final tweet has CTA

description: Ad Copy Agent generates Facebook ad with multiple variations
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents and select Ad Copy Agent
Step 2: Select a client with active campaigns
Step 3: Choose 'Facebook/Instagram Ad' type
Step 4: Enter ad objective and product details
Step 5: Request 5 variations
Step 6: Click Generate
Step 7: Verify 5 distinct ad variations are generated
Step 8: Check each variation has: Primary Text, Headline, Description
Step 9: Verify variations use different angles/hooks
Step 10: Confirm compliance with character limits

description: Ad Copy Agent generates Google Ads copy with all required fields
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Ad Copy Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'Google Ads' type
Step 4: Enter keywords and landing page URL
Step 5: Click Generate
Step 6: Verify output includes: Headlines (30 char each), Descriptions (90 char)
Step 7: Check at least 15 headline variations generated
Step 8: Verify at least 4 description variations
Step 9: Confirm keywords are incorporated naturally
Step 10: Check display URL path suggestions

description: Ad Copy Agent checks content against constitution rules
steps: Step 1: Create constitution rule that blocks certain words (e.g., 'guaranteed')
Step 2: Navigate to Ad Copy Agent
Step 3: Select client with the constitution rule
Step 4: Generate ad copy for product
Step 5: Verify generated copy does not contain blocked words
Step 6: Check if compliance indicator shows 'passed' status
Step 7: Attempt to manually add blocked word and regenerate
Step 8: Confirm warning or auto-replacement occurs

description: Video Script Agent generates UGC-style script with structure
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents and select Video Script Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'UGC-Style Video' type
Step 4: Enter product and target audience
Step 5: Click Generate
Step 6: Verify script has Hook section (attention grabber)
Step 7: Check Problem section identifies pain point
Step 8: Verify Solution section presents product
Step 9: Confirm Benefits/Features are listed
Step 10: Check CTA section with clear action
Step 11: Verify script includes suggested shot types or visual notes

description: Video Script Agent generates talking head script with timestamps
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Video Script Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'Talking Head' type
Step 4: Enter topic and target duration (2 minutes)
Step 5: Click Generate
Step 6: Verify script is approximately 2 minutes when read aloud
Step 7: Check timestamp markers are included (0:00, 0:30, 1:00, etc.)
Step 8: Verify B-roll suggestions at appropriate moments
Step 9: Confirm natural conversational tone
Step 10: Check speaker cues are included

description: Content Strategy Agent generates 30-day editorial calendar
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents and select Content Strategy Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'Editorial Calendar' type
Step 4: Set period to 30 days
Step 5: Enter content pillars and goals
Step 6: Click Generate
Step 7: Verify calendar shows 30 days of content suggestions
Step 8: Check each day has: content type, topic, platform, brief
Step 9: Verify mix of content types (posts, videos, stories)
Step 10: Confirm content aligns with provided pillars
Step 11: Check calendar can be exported or saved

description: Content Strategy Agent generates content pillar suggestions
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Content Strategy Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'Content Pillars' type
Step 4: Enter niche and target audience
Step 5: Click Generate
Step 6: Verify 4-6 content pillars are suggested
Step 7: Check each pillar has: name, description, example topics
Step 8: Confirm pillars cover different aspects of the niche
Step 9: Verify alignment with client's brand voice

description: SMS/WhatsApp Agent generates compliant SMS under 160 characters
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents and select SMS/WhatsApp Agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Choose 'SMS Campaign' type
Step 4: Enter campaign objective
Step 5: Click Generate
Step 6: Verify SMS is under 160 characters
Step 7: Check character counter is displayed
Step 8: Verify opt-out text is mentioned if required
Step 9: Confirm link placeholder is included
Step 10: Check multiple variations are generated

description: Agent generation streams response in real-time via SSE
steps: Step 1: Navigate to any agent and configure generation
Step 2: Open browser dev tools Network tab
Step 3: Click Generate
Step 4: Verify SSE connection is established
Step 5: Watch text appear progressively in output area
Step 6: Confirm response is not all-at-once
Step 7: Check streaming indicator is visible during generation

description: Agent output can be regenerated without losing input
steps: Step 1: Navigate to any agent
Step 2: Fill in all inputs and generate content
Step 3: Wait for output to complete
Step 4: Click 'Regenerate' button
Step 5: Verify inputs are preserved
Step 6: Confirm new output is different from previous
Step 7: Check generation count increments

description: Agent output can be saved to creative assets
steps: Step 1: Navigate to any agent and generate content
Step 2: Wait for output to complete
Step 3: Click 'Save to Assets' or 'Save' button
Step 4: Select target campaign (optional)
Step 5: Confirm save action
Step 6: Navigate to client's creative assets
Step 7: Verify saved content appears in assets list
Step 8: Check metadata includes agent type and generation date

description: Agent output can be copied to clipboard
steps: Step 1: Navigate to any agent and generate content
Step 2: Wait for output to complete
Step 3: Click 'Copy' button on output section
Step 4: Verify success toast/notification appears
Step 5: Paste in external application
Step 6: Confirm content was copied correctly

description: Agent uses brand voice from client context in generation
steps: Step 1: Update client's brand voice with specific tone (e.g., 'casual and humorous')
Step 2: Navigate to Email Agent and select that client
Step 3: Generate welcome email
Step 4: Verify generated content matches casual/humorous tone
Step 5: Change to different client with formal brand voice
Step 6: Generate same email type
Step 7: Confirm tone is now formal
Step 8: Verify both outputs are distinct in style

description: Agent uses ICP data to personalize content
steps: Step 1: Update client's ICP with specific pain points
Step 2: Navigate to Landing Page Agent and select that client
Step 3: Generate landing page for a product
Step 4: Verify Problem section addresses the specific pain points from ICP
Step 5: Check Solution section speaks to ICP's desires
Step 6: Confirm language matches ICP's demographics

description: Agent queries and uses top performing hooks from performance memory
steps: Step 1: Add performance memory entries for a client with high-scoring hooks
Step 2: Navigate to Ad Copy Agent and select that client
Step 3: Generate ad copy
Step 4: Verify generated hooks are inspired by top performers
Step 5: Check 'Inspired by' or 'Based on' indicator shows source
Step 6: Confirm hooks maintain brand consistency while leveraging proven patterns

description: Agent generation history is logged and viewable
steps: Step 1: Generate content with multiple agents
Step 2: Navigate to agent history/activity section
Step 3: Verify recent generations are listed
Step 4: Check each entry shows: agent type, client, timestamp, preview
Step 5: Click on a history entry
Step 6: Verify full output is viewable
Step 7: Confirm option to reuse/regenerate from history

description: Custom prompt presets can be created and saved per client
steps: Step 1: Navigate to any agent
Step 2: Select a client
Step 3: Expand custom prompt editor
Step 4: Edit system prompt with custom instructions
Step 5: Click 'Save as Preset' button
Step 6: Enter preset name (e.g., 'Client X Special Tone')
Step 7: Save the preset
Step 8: Verify preset appears in dropdown for that client
Step 9: Select different agent for same client
Step 10: Confirm custom preset is available there too

description: Agent respects constitution compliance rules during generation
steps: Step 1: Create constitution rule blocking 'free' and '100% guarantee'
Step 2: Navigate to Ad Copy Agent
Step 3: Select client with constitution rules
Step 4: Enter brief that would naturally include blocked terms
Step 5: Generate ad copy
Step 6: Verify output avoids blocked terms
Step 7: Check compliance badge shows 'Compliant' status
Step 8: Verify alternative phrasing was used instead

description: Agent tool calling retrieves active campaigns for context
steps: Step 1: Create multiple active campaigns for a client with different angles
Step 2: Navigate to Ad Copy Agent and select that client
Step 3: Generate ad copy
Step 4: Verify generated copy aligns with active campaign angles
Step 5: Check if user can select specific campaign to align with
Step 6: Select specific campaign and regenerate
Step 7: Confirm output is more specifically aligned with that campaign's angle

description: Email Builder and Landing Page removed from Reports and now in Agents
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /reports
Step 2: Verify Email Builder tab is no longer present
Step 3: Verify Landing Page tab is no longer present
Step 4: Reports page only shows reports functionality
Step 5: Navigate to /agents
Step 6: Verify Email Agent card is present
Step 7: Verify Landing Page Agent card is present

description: Agent usage statistics display tokens and generations count
steps: Step 1: Navigate to Agents hub
Step 2: Generate content with multiple agents
Step 3: Find usage statistics section
Step 4: Verify total tokens used this month is displayed
Step 5: Check total generations count is accurate
Step 6: Verify per-agent breakdown is available
Step 7: Confirm cost estimate is shown if applicable

description: Agents hub page has modern grid layout with hover effects
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents
Step 2: Take screenshot of agents grid
Step 3: Verify cards have consistent styling
Step 4: Hover over agent card
Step 5: Confirm hover effect (scale, shadow, or border highlight)
Step 6: Check spacing is consistent between cards
Step 7: Verify responsive behavior on smaller screens

description: Agent generation interface has clear visual hierarchy
steps: Step 1: Open any agent generation interface
Step 2: Verify client selector is prominent at top
Step 3: Check input areas are clearly labeled
Step 4: Verify Generate button is visually prominent
Step 5: Confirm output area is visually distinct from input
Step 6: Check loading state has clear indicator
Step 7: Verify action buttons (copy, save, regenerate) are accessible

description: Agent cards have distinct icons for each agent type
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents
Step 2: Verify Email Agent has email/envelope icon
Step 3: Check Landing Page Agent has page/web icon
Step 4: Verify Social Media Agent has social icons
Step 5: Check Ad Copy Agent has megaphone/ad icon
Step 6: Verify Video Script Agent has video/film icon
Step 7: Confirm icons are consistent size and style

description: Prompt preset dropdown has clear visual styling
steps: Step 1: Open any agent interface
Step 2: Locate prompt preset dropdown
Step 3: Verify dropdown has clear label
Step 4: Open dropdown and check options are readable
Step 5: Verify selected option is visually indicated
Step 6: Check dropdown works in dark mode

description: Agent output preview has proper formatting and sections
steps: Step 1: Generate content with any agent
Step 2: Wait for output to complete
Step 3: Verify output sections are visually separated
Step 4: Check headings are bold and distinct
Step 5: Verify body text is readable
Step 6: Confirm variations are clearly numbered if multiple
Step 7: Check code/special formatting is preserved

description: Complete end-to-end agent workflow: select agent, configure, generate, save
steps: Step 1: Navigate to /agents
Step 2: Click on Email Sequence Agent card
Step 3: Select a client from dropdown
Step 4: Verify client context is loaded (brand voice indicator)
Step 5: Select 'Welcome Email' type
Step 6: Choose 'Friendly' prompt preset
Step 7: Enter brief describing the welcome email goal
Step 8: Click Generate button
Step 9: Watch streaming output appear
Step 10: Verify complete email is generated with all elements
Step 11: Click 'Save to Assets' button
Step 12: Select target campaign (optional)
Step 13: Confirm save
Step 14: Navigate to client's creative assets
Step 15: Verify email appears in saved assets

description: Agent handles API errors gracefully with retry option
steps: Step 1: Navigate to any agent
Step 2: Configure generation parameters
Step 3: Simulate API error (disconnect network briefly)
Step 4: Click Generate
Step 5: Verify error message is displayed clearly
Step 6: Check 'Retry' button is available
Step 7: Reconnect network and click Retry
Step 8: Confirm generation proceeds successfully

description: Agent supports keyboard shortcuts for common actions
steps: Step 1: Navigate to any agent interface
Step 2: Fill in required inputs
Step 3: Press Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to generate
Step 4: Verify generation starts
Step 5: After output, press Cmd/Ctrl+C to copy
Step 6: Verify content is copied
Step 7: Press Cmd/Ctrl+S to save
Step 8: Verify save dialog appears

description: Agent generation can be cancelled mid-stream
steps: Step 1: Navigate to any agent
Step 2: Configure and start generation
Step 3: While streaming, click 'Cancel' or 'Stop' button
Step 4: Verify generation stops immediately
Step 5: Check partial output is preserved
Step 6: Verify can start new generation without issues
